import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime format and extract day of the week
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['day_of_week'] = coffee_sales['date'].dt.day_name()

# Calculate total sales per day of the week
sales_per_day = coffee_sales.groupby('day_of_week')['total'].sum().reindex(['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=sales_per_day.index, y=sales_per_day.values, palette="viridis")

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Day of the Week', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales by Day of the Week', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime format and extract day of the week
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['day_of_week'] = coffee_sales['date'].dt.day_name()

# Calculate total sales per day of the week
sales_per_day = coffee_sales.groupby('day_of_week')['total'].sum().reindex(['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=sales_per_day.index, y=sales_per_day.values, palette="viridis")

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Day of the Week', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales by Day of the Week', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
